title: Projection vocabularies

dataset.name: Any global field: Blue Marble on the left (ortho-cog-viewer default), DKRZ d3hp003 z7 on the right

left.label: ours (ortho-cog-viewer: proj4js, omerc centred, interrupted Goode, tpers)

right.label: gridlook (d3-geo and d3-geo-projection, globe plus flat views)

gap: Neither side is behind; the vocabularies differ. d3-geo gives gridlook many named projections but no PROJ strings or EPSG codes beyond 3857; proj4js gives us PROJ strings and a resolver, but the interrupted and oblique presets are hand-added.
bridge: proj-wasm as a shared resolver on an unknown-code miss, so both shells can accept a PROJ string or EPSG code and fall back to the same definition authority.
